title.narrative: TZA Research Cooperation with UDSM 2024-2030 - ISP allowances

description.narrative: A final support to the University of Dar es Salaam (UDSM) for the programme ‘Research and Innovation for Sustainable and Inclusive Development in Tanzania’. The overall objective of the programme is to consolidate and strengthen research capacity at UDSM to contribute to sustainable capacity to conduct research relevant to poverty reduction and socially, economically and environmentally sustainable development. The programme comprises 8 sub-programmes, including 7 postgraduate programmes in various relevant research areas related to Tanzania's development (mathematics, marine, water resources and sanitation, fossil-free energy and IT, women's entrepreneurship, food security and biotechnology) and a research support programme (research administration and communication, quality assurance of postgraduate education and innovation systems, and intellectual property). The programme will be implemented by UDSM in partnership with 8 Swedish universities. UDSM has locally accredited PhD programmes that have been developed together with Swedish partners and UDSM is deemed to have sufficient in-house supervision capacity in these areas.

Ett avslutande stöd till University of Dar es Salaam (UDSM) för programmet “Forskning och Innovation för Hållbar och Inkluderande Utveckling i Tanzania”. Programmets övergripande mål är att konsolidera samt stärka forskningskapaciteten vid UDSM för att bidra till hållbar kapacitet att bedriva forskning som är relevant för fattigdomsbekämpning och socialt, ekonomiskt och miljömässigt hållbar utveckling. Programmet innehåller 8 delprogram, varav 7 forskarutbildningsprogram inom olika relevanta forskningsområden relaterade till Tanzanias utveckling (matematik, marint, vattenresurser och sanitet, fossilfri energi och IT, kvinnors företagande, livsmedelssäkerhet och bioteknologi) samt ett forskningsstödjandeprogram (forskningsadministration och -kommunikation, kvalitetssäkring av forskarutbildning och innovationssystem och immaterialrätt). Programmet kommer att implementeras av UDSM i partnerskap med 8 svenska universitet. UDSM har lokal ackrediterade doktorandprogram som har utvecklats tillsammans med svenska partners och UDSM bedöms ha tillräcklig egen handledningskapacitet inom dessa områden.

The UDSM proposal Research and Innovation for Sustainable and Inclusive Development in Tanzania aims to: Build research and innovation capacity through postgraduate training in priority areas relevant for engendering inclusive and sustainable development; improve research and innovation management systems/environment; upscale the dissemination and commercialisation of research results and innovation products toward addressing societal needs. There are 7 thematic research training sub-programs and one research-support sub-program.
Programme Specific Objectives
To enhance research and innovation capacity through postgraduate training focusing on priority areas with at least 50% female. To improve the research and innovation environment (digitalisation platform, equipment and infrastructure, engendered regulations, policies and guidelines). To increase the quality and use of research and innovation outputs to address gender mainstreamed societal needs. To strengthen gender-based community engagement and collaboration with local, regional and international partners for knowledge generation, sharing and utilisation of research results and innovation outputs.
Research training: Implement programmes in institutional and national interest areas and increase the quality and use of research and innovation outputs to address gender mainstreamed societal needs.
Research-support component
Specific objectives:
To enhance the efficiency of research and innovation management at the UDSM. To reinforce the relevance and capacity to improve the quality of research and innovation outputs. To facilitate the dissemination of research and innovation results to end-users. To fortify the networks and collaboration between education, research and innovation system and relevant stakeholders
